name: Beans
overview: Scripture acknowledges beans as part of the provision God has given for human sustenance, as seen in Genesis 1:29 where God grants every herb bearing seed for food. Ezekiel 4:9 specifically includes beans among the grains used to make bread during a time of trial, highlighting their role in daily nourishment. The inclusion of beans alongside other staple foods reflects God's provision and care for His people even in difficult circumstances.
